notes: Vessel calls from free public pilot/terminal plans (Tan Cang Pilot + Cảng vụ Hải Phòng port authority, fetched daily); times beyond the published plan, berth windows & TEU are modelled estimates; AISstream live feed not connected
TEU figures are model estimates from draft & port stay — not terminal-confirmed lifts
National trade totals are official (GDVC); province/commodity split is a demo model
Monthly national/region throughput is real VPA association data
ICD volumes & barge flows are corridor-model estimates (see Inland network notes)
Port-stay predictions learn from AIS-observed stay history (per vessel, then class-at-port, then class default) — basis shown per call
